stage_name_zh: 阶段 4：顶会论文、具身智能/生成建模、学术演讲与全周期综合复习（Day 76–116）
learning_objectives_zh: 全周期巩固第 111 天预定间隔复习词群，强化多义辨析与跨场景（AI/时序/具身智能论文、演讲、六级/雅思托福）主动写作。
掌握句子成分精细分析（主、谓、宾、表、定、状、同位语）与核心语法：【G003】主谓一致、数量短语一致与邻近名词干扰排除；【G008】语序、否定辖域、部分否定与句首否定倒装。
掌握学术表达模式：【EP015】章节过渡与Given-New指代衔接（This + 总结名词），彻底消除头重脚轻、口语化、过度表达与空洞 AI 套话。
完成 36 道高密度、单点聚焦的实战练习，确保今日每个词条均获得至少 3 次训练（含至少 2 次主动输出）。

grammar_instruction.name: 主谓一致、数量短语一致与邻近名词干扰排除
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 复杂主语的主谓一致取决于核心名词（Head Noun）而非后置介词短语中的邻近名词。尤其需区分 a number of 与 the number of，以及 along with / accompanied by / as well as 连接的附加成分。
rules: the number of + 复数名词作主语，谓语用单数；a (large/small) number of + 复数名词作主语，谓语用复数。
主语后接 along with, together with, accompanied by, as well as 时，谓语动词与前面的核心主语保持一致。
the bulk of / a proportion of / a percentage of + 名词作主语时，谓语单复数取决于 of 后的名词是不可数/单数还是复数可数名词。
means, series 单复数同形，谓语由限定词决定（a series of observations was vs two series were）。
examples: The number of completed interviews was recorded separately.
A small number of respondents left this item blank.
The bulk of the evidence comes from observational studies.
One of the surveys was conducted online.
common_errors: 被 of 短语中的复数名词误导：*The analysis of interview responses show（应为 shows）。
把 as well as 误当成 and 改变主语单复数。

grammar_instruction.name: 语序、否定辖域、部分否定与句首否定倒装
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 精确控制否定与限定副词（only, solely, merely, by no means, under no circumstances, rarely, seldom）的辖域。当否定或唯一下界短语置于句首时，主句必须采用部分倒装。
rules: 区分全部否定（none of, in no way, under no circumstances, by no means）与部分否定（not all, not necessarily, not always）。
当 by no means, in no way, under no circumstances, in no circumstances, on no account, rarely, seldom, only when... 置于句首时，主句必须部分倒装（助动词/be/情态动词提至主语前）。
间接疑问从句（assess to what extent the results depend on...）一律保持陈述语序，不倒装。
examples: By no means is the result certain. (对比句中：A large sample is by no means sufficient to eliminate systematic bias.)
Under no circumstances should test labels be used for model tuning.
Only when the protocol was approved did recruitment begin.
common_errors: 句首否定强调漏掉倒装：*Under no circumstances test labels should be used。
间接疑问句误用倒装：*examine how does the system behave（应为 how the system behaves）。

grammar_instruction.name: 情态动词、确定性梯度与科学谨慎表达（Epistemic Hedging）
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 科学写作要求结论的语气强度与实验/数据证据的完备度严格对齐。通过情态动词（may, might, can, could）、认知副词（arguably, apparently, plausibly, relatively, typically）及谨慎动词（suggest, indicate, point to, appear to）控制断言边界。
rules: 当存在未测混杂（unmeasured confounding）、小样本或仿真环境限制时，必须使用 may be attributable to / suggests that / supports a tentative conclusion。
禁止在经验研究中滥用 irrefutable, undeniable, inevitable, universal, conclusively prove；只有经核实的数学反例推翻全称命题时才可用 disprove / irrefutable。
examples: The observed discrepancy may be attributable to differences in measurement procedures.
A distributional forecast is arguably more informative when decisions depend on tail risk.
The verified counterexample provides irrefutable evidence that the universal mathematical claim is false.
common_errors: 在改写或总结时删去原句的 may / arguably / in this sample 等限定词，造成过度绝对化。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 章节过渡与Given-New指代衔接（This + 总结名词）
expression_pattern_instruction.template: This [discrepancy/limitation/pattern] motivates our next analysis, where we turn to [next topic] in greater detail.
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 用 This + 范畴名词总结上句结果并自然开启下一句或下一节。
examples: An anomaly in the sensor readings prompted a check of the calibration procedure.
We now turn to the evaluation criteria.
common_errors: 使用指代不清的裸 This 作主语。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 全篇总结与后续研究动议（Conclusion & Future Directions）
expression_pattern_instruction.template: In summary, the empirical evidence supports [claim] under [tested conditions], while the remaining anomalies warrant further investigation in [future setting].
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 收束全文核心贡献，不夸大、不遗漏边界条件。
examples: The discrepancy warrants further investigation, but it does not warrant a causal conclusion.
The authors conclude that further external validation is needed.
common_errors: *warrant to do（应为 warrant + 名词/doing）。
